metaDescription: Kevin theorizes frontier AI labs are heading toward merger and nationalization with taxpayer bailouts, citing america.gov, Stargate Argentina and Milei.
summary: Kevin theorizes that AI is already too big to fail and that frontier labs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI and Google are moving toward a merger and nationalization funded by taxpayers. He points to the government's america.gov AI site as a possible way to train models on user behavior, and says he has no proof. He also plays a Whitney Webb clip about Stargate Argentina and Javier Milei's AI policies, and says Peter Thiel has relocated there. Kevin presents all of this as speculation. He frames the argument as thinking out loud and not as a firm prediction.
